milestone.title: Agent ergonomics — JSON projection, structured filters, summary rollups, bulk review ops

intent.outcome: Agents using mp run tight read/loop workflows without shelling out to python3/jq to slice JSON, fanning out N subprocess calls to classify artifacts, recomputing rollups, or looping bulk writes. The common agent patterns observed during the 2026-07-01 review-backlog sweep (project fields, filter artifacts, aggregate, bulk-resolve reviews, triage a queue) are first-class mp commands.

problem.description: During the 2026-07-01 review-backlog sweep the agent wrapped nearly every mp JSON emit in ad-hoc shell glue: (1) python3 to project one or two fields because mp emits whole objects (~15 occurrences; idea ID-08); (2) a 66-call python loop over `mp show milestone` to classify reviews by evidence text, because there is no structured filter and no bulk detail in one call; (3) python Counter to roll up validate warnings by code and reviews by month, because mp has no summary mode; (4) a 66-call python loop of `mp reviews pass` because there is no bulk resolve. mp is agent-only JSON, so these recurring agent reads/writes should be first-class. Each ad-hoc glue is a drift risk (guessing JSON keys) and a clarity/perf cost.

in_scope: JSON projection: --fields a.b.c on read commands (show/list/status/validate/reviews) — promotes idea ID-08
Structured filters: list milestones --where <field><op><value> and --filter <preset> (force-bypassed, spec-status=…); plus bulk detail (--include steps/acs) so agents don't fan out
Summary/rollup modes: mp validate --summary (counts by code), mp reviews pending --group-by <field>
Bulk review resolve: mp reviews pass --all --filter <preset> --verdict --reviewer --notes (sequential under the hood, per-item results)
Review-sweep/triage: mp reviews sweep classifies the pending queue into force-bypassed / manual-only / runnable buckets with counts + IDs (productizes the manual 2026-07-01 triage)
out_of_scope: raul human-surface changes — these are agent ergonomics; raul is a separate surface
Changing the default emission format (JSON stays default; projection/filter/summary are opt-in flags)
Rewriting the data model or persistence layer
Automating the per-AC deep-review process itself (that is review process, not ergonomics)

acceptance_criteria.description: --fields projects one or more dotted JSON paths on every read command that emits JSON (show/list/status/validate/reviews), returning only the projected fields

list milestones --filter <preset> (e.g. force-bypassed) and --where <field><op><value> return only matching milestones in a single call, and --include steps/acs embeds full detail so no fan-out is needed
mp validate --summary returns ok/error counts and warnings grouped by code; mp reviews pending --group-by <field> returns grouped counts
mp reviews pass --all --filter <preset> --verdict --reviewer --notes resolves a batch in one command (sequential internally, no parallelize risk) and prints a per-item result summary
mp reviews sweep classifies the pending queue into force-bypassed / manual-only / runnable buckets with counts and IDs, built on the filter + summary primitives

mp scratch path prints (creating if absent) a gitignored in-repo scratch directory; mp scratch new <label> creates a unique subdirectory under it; AGENTS.md and the master-planner skill instruct agents to stage scratch via mp scratch instead of reaching for /tmp

design_decisions.choice: --fields accepts dotted JSON paths (e.g. milestone.spec_status, steps[].status); arrays via [i] or [] (all elements); unknown path is a HARD error (exit non-zero naming the bad path), never a silent omit; output mirrors the requested paths.
design_decisions.rationale: Agents depend on exact field names; silently omitting a misspelled path would mask mistakes - the very drift risk this milestone removes. Mirroring requested paths in output keeps projections composable.

work_packages.name: JSON projection (--fields)
work_packages.goal: Agents project specific JSON fields on read commands without slicing in shell

work_packages.name: Structured filters + bulk detail
work_packages.goal: Agents filter artifacts by field/preset and fetch full detail in one call

work_packages.name: Summary / rollup modes
work_packages.goal: Agents get counts and group-by without recomputing in shell

work_packages.name: Bulk review resolve
work_packages.goal: Agents resolve a batch of reviews in one command

work_packages.name: Review-sweep / triage
work_packages.goal: Agents get a risk-bucketed work-plan of the pending review queue

work_packages.name: In-repo scratch (mp scratch)
work_packages.goal: Agents get/put scratch files in-repo without external /tmp

steps.action: Implement --fields dotted-path projection across read emitters (show, list milestones, status, validate, reviews pending); output mirrors requested paths
steps.done_when: Projecting milestone.spec_status on `mp show milestone <id>` returns only that field across all read commands

steps.action: Projection semantics: array indexing ([i] and [] all-elements); hard-error on unknown path, naming the offending path in the message
steps.done_when: Arrays indexable; unknown path exits non-zero and names the bad path

steps.action: Add --filter <preset> (force-bypassed, spec-status=ready/planned) and --where <field><op><value> (ops ~= == !=) to list milestones, evaluated in one call
steps.done_when: `--filter force-bypassed` returns exactly the force-bypassed milestones in one call

steps.action: Add --include <steps|acceptance_criteria|evidence> to list milestones so agents fetch full detail without N fan-out calls
steps.done_when: list milestones --include steps returns steps inline per milestone

steps.action: Add --summary to validate (ok/error counts + warnings grouped by code) and --group-by <field> to reviews pending (e.g. completed_at month)
steps.done_when: validate --summary emits counts-by-code; reviews pending --group-by month emits per-group counts

steps.action: Add --all/--filter/--verdict/--reviewer/--notes to reviews pass; resolve sequentially under the hood (reuse per-milestone write) and print a per-item pass/fail summary
steps.done_when: reviews pass --all --filter force-bypassed --verdict ok resolves the matching set in one command with a result summary

steps.action: Add reviews sweep (alias: triage) that buckets pending reviews into force-bypassed / manual-only / runnable with counts and IDs, built on the WP2 filters and WP3 summary primitives
steps.done_when: sweep output buckets the current pending queue; counts match a fresh manual triage

steps.action: Implement mp scratch path (prints and creates the in-repo gitignored scratch dir, resolved relative to project root / MP_HOME) and mp scratch new <label> (unique subdir under it); add the scratch dir to .gitignore
steps.done_when: mp scratch path prints an existing in-repo dir; mp scratch new foo creates a unique subdir; the dir is gitignored

steps.action: Document the scratch convention in AGENTS.md and the master-planner skill so agents stage scratch via mp scratch path/new instead of /tmp
steps.tests: manual: accepted - AGENTS.md + skill text review
steps.done_when: AGENTS.md and skill text instruct agents to use mp scratch for in-repo scratch files
